thread:
maria-support: FYI Acme reporting a burst of 429s on their dedicated pool (dedicated-us-east-2) since ~09:10 UTC. They say it correlates with very long context requests. Logs attached in ticket.

raj-sre: Can you paste the tenant ID and one example request? 429 should show as `throttle.kv_cache` if it's eviction-driven.

maria-support: tenant=acme-prod-42. Example request payload (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{"model":"rwd-large","input": "<10k tokens prefix>...<80k tokens context>...","max_tokens": 2048}'
```
They said it started after a rollout yesterday but uncertain. Customer notes errors spike on bursts of 6 concurrent long-context calls.

ahana-oncall: thanks. I'm pulling autoscaler + kv metrics now. @raj-sre can you check `kv_cache.evictions_total` and `kv_cache.memory_frag_ratio` for that pool? Also check if any noisy tenant had a mem leak.

raj-sre: quick check from monitoring (09:00-09:30 UTC):
```
kv_cache.evictions_total{pool="dedicated-us-east-2"}  ->  18k -> spike at 09:11
kv_cache.throttle_count{tenant="acme-prod-42"} -> 129
kv_cache.memory_frag_ratio{host=~"rwd-ded-*"} -> 0.74
tenant_kv_alloc_bytes{tenant="acme-prod-42"} -> 3.1GiB (limit 4GiB)
autoscaler.scaled_replicas{pool="dedicated-us-east-2"} -> scaled down at 08:50 -> scaled up at 09:14
request.p95_latency{pool="dedicated-us-east-2"} -> 620ms -> 1.2s during spike
```
Looks like a spike in evictions and fragmentation right when they ran concurrent long-context requests. Autoscaler briefly scaled down then back up; might have amplified pressure.

maria-support: customer says they saw their requests fail with: `{"error":"quota_exceeded","code":"KV_CACHE_THROTTLE","detail":"kv eviction thrashing"}`. They asked if we can temporarily raise their kv allocation.

dave-ml: long contexts blow up KV sizes because KV scales with sequence length x layers. If they pass 80k tokens we can easily multiply memory per key. Options: a) short-circuit fallback to chunked context b) set per-tenant max_context_tokens c) increase kv limit. For immediate relief, limiting concurrent long-contexts is fastest.

ahana-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) increase tenant_kv_limit for acme-prod-42 from 4GiB -> 5GiB temporarily, 2) pin them to model variant `rwd-large-8k` (or set runtime to truncation/segmented mode), 3) schedule compaction job to defragment hosts. I'll open a quick config patch.

maria-support: customer ok with temporary increase if it reduces errors. They want ETA.

raj-sre: small config patch to tenant allocation (preview):
```yaml
tenants:
  acme-prod-42:
    kv_memory_limit_bytes: 5368709120 # 5GiB
    max_context_tokens: 8192
    allowed_variants: ["rwd-large-8k","rwd-medium-8k"]
```
I'll apply to the control plane and request rolling config refresh for the pool.

infra-bot: [autoscaler] Detected scale event: pool=dedicated-us-east-2 action=scale_up to 12 replicas at 09:14:21 UTC

infra-bot: [deploy] Tenant allocation patch applied to control plane (deploy-id: dp-9842) - rolling refresh started.

ahana-oncall: I've also triggered a host-level mem compaction on rwd-ded-03 and rwd-ded-07 (high frag). Commands run: `svc compaction --hosts rwd-ded-03,rwd-ded-07 --force`

raj-sre: after changes (09:20-09:45 UTC) metric excerpt:
```
kv_cache.evictions_total{tenant="acme-prod-42"} -> 18k -> 18.6k (flat)
kv_cache.throttle_count{tenant="acme-prod-42"} -> 129 -> 4
kv_cache.memory_frag_ratio{host=~"rwd-ded-*"} -> 0.74 -> 0.62
request.p95_latency{pool="dedicated-us-east-2"} -> 1.2s -> 610ms
```
Evictions still high historically but throttle_count dropped significantly. Looks effective.

maria-support: relayed to customer, they confirmed error rate dropped in the last 10 minutes and only occasional 429s. :thumbsup: They asked for a permanent fix.

dave-ml: For long term: recommend: 1) model variant with kv-compression and chunked attention for >8k contexts, 2) default per-tenant concurrency limits for long contexts, 3) scheduler change to avoid scaling-down during transient peaks in KV-heavy workloads. I'll open RFC.

ahana-oncall: I'll follow up with a postmortem draft and an action item to add tenant-level early rejection for >32k tokens with recommendation to shard. Also add an alert to not scale down below min_replicas when avg_kv_evictions > threshold.

maria-support: Thanks team. Closing loop with Acme and tagging for PS engagement.

infra-bot: [deploy] Rolling refresh completed for pool dedicated-us-east-2 (dp-9842) at 09:32:10 UTC

maria-support: Customer reports after 09:35 UTC they saw zero 429s during a 15-min retest. Good to close for now, will reopen if it recurs.

raj-sre: leaving notes: reproducer steps saved to ticket TG-4091, add unit test for autoscaler not scaling below min_replicas on KV-heavy signals.

dave-ml: filing RFC #1201 for kv compression + longctx policy.

ahana-oncall: marking done on immediate mitigation.
